<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="UbLt5jr-C6_8xOWt3kwG"> <mxGraphModel dx="1609" dy="1067" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
	autonumber
	participant Kafka as Kafka topic:<br/>auth.events
	participant LCons as Ledger<br/>KafkaConsumer
	participant Hdr as Kafka<br/>HeaderReader
	participant LProc as Ledger<br/>EventProcessor
	participant AuthH as Authorisation<br/>AuthorisedHandler
	participant CapH as Authorisation<br/>CapturedHandler
	participant RevH as Authorisation<br/>ReversedHandler
	participant PRepo as ProcessedEvent<br/>Repository
	participant LLog as LedgerEventLog<br/>Repository
	participant LEntry as LedgerEntry<br/>Repository

	Kafka-->>LCons: consume record(key,<br/>value, headers)
	LCons->>Hdr: read(headers)
	Hdr-->>LCons: EventMetadata
	LCons->>LProc: process(metadata, rawPayload)

	alt eventType == AUTHORISATION_AUTHORISED
		LProc->>AuthH: handle(metadata, rawPayload)
		AuthH->>PRepo: tryInsertProcessedEvent(eventId,<br/>type, processedAt)
		alt first-time event
			AuthH->>LLog: save(event log)
			AuthH->>LEntry: save(ledger entry)
		else duplicate
			Note over AuthH,PRepo: skip duplicate event
		end
	else eventType == AUTHORISATION_CAPTURED
		LProc->>CapH: handle(metadata, rawPayload)
		CapH->>PRepo: tryInsertProcessedEvent(eventId,<br/>type, processedAt)
		alt first-time event
			CapH->>LLog: save(event log)
			CapH->>LEntry: save(ledger entry)
		else duplicate
			Note over CapH,PRepo: skip duplicate event
		end
	else eventType == AUTHORISATION_REVERSED
		LProc->>RevH: handle(metadata, rawPayload)
		RevH->>PRepo: tryInsertProcessedEvent(eventId,<br/>type, processedAt)
		alt first-time event
			RevH->>LLog: save(event log)
			RevH->>LEntry: save(ledger entry)
		else duplicate
			Note over RevH,PRepo: skip duplicate event
		end
	else eventType == AUTHORISATION_DECLINED
		Note over LProc: Intentional no-op - logged at debug and dropped.<br/>No handler, no processed_event row, no ledger entry.<br/>(A DECLINED authorisation never affected balances, so there is<br/>nothing to project.)
	else unsupported / unknown event type
		LProc-->>LCons: throw IllegalArgumentException
		Note over LCons,Kafka: Non-retryable - DefaultErrorHandler routes straight to<br/>auth.events.ledger.dlt via DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer
	else other runtime failure (e.g. DB unavailable)
		LProc-->>LCons: throw RuntimeException
		Note over LCons,Kafka: Retryable - retried 3x with 2s fixed backoff,<br/>then routed to auth.events.ledger.dlt if still failing
	end



",
 "config": null

div.div:
Intentional no-op - logged at debug and dropped.
No handler, no processed_event row, no ledger entry.
(A DECLINED authorisation never affected balances, so there is
nothing to project.)
